title: locallibrary keybinds
description: keybinds.json: the keys set in locallibrary's player, beside tui.json. Only the actions whose keys differ from the player's defaults, by id. An id the player doesn't know is kept and ignored, and a key it can't read is skipped when the file is applied.

keys.description:
The actions whose keys differ from the player's defaults, by id, sorted: each one's keys in
order (for `deck.hot-cue`, the nth key plays the nth hot cue), or none for no key. A key is
one character as typed (a capital is shift and the letter), `space`, `enter`, `tab`,
`backspace`, `delete`, `insert`, `home`, `end`, `pageup`, `pagedown`, `up`, `down`, `left`,
`right`, `f1` to `f12`, `shift-` and one of those names but the f keys, or `ctrl-` and a
lowercase letter.

from.description: The account some of these keys were imported from (a DID), for credit.
